summary: A Wimbledon family dental practice appears to lose new patients to old awards, a Covid-19 menu item and an undated footer.

findings.problem: A Covid-19 item still appears in the main menu.
findings.cost: Old pandemic pages make the practice look stuck in an earlier year.
findings.fix: Remove or replace it with a patient info page.

findings.problem: The newest awards shown appear to be from 2013 and 2016.
findings.cost: Old awards read as old proof, so new patients trust recent reviews on other sites more.
findings.fix: Recent reviews and awards with dates.

findings.problem: The footer appears to show a copyright with no year.
findings.cost: A missing year suggests the site is not kept current.
findings.fix: A footer with the current year.

findings.problem: A Send a Selfie item appears in the menu with no explanation.
findings.cost: Unclear menu items confuse new patients.
findings.fix: Clear labels for every menu item.
